manifest.name: dsh-db-studio
manifest.description: Connect to databases in DeepSeek Harness (DSH), then query and edit data right in the conversation.

scripts.check: node --check lib/index.js && node --check lib/service.js && node --check lib/drivers.js && node --check lib/store.js && node --check lib/home.js && node --check lib/client.js

manifest.author: Jianjun Xiao <et_shaw@126.com>

bundle.text:
# dsh-db-studio bundle patch.
#
# `dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-db-studio` reads this file and appends the
# row below to the profile's bundle stack. The `name` is the npm package name,
# so Node module resolution finds the installed package.
- insert:
    - id: db-studio
      name: dsh-db-studio
      config:
        demo: true
        allowWrite: true

readme.text:
简体中文 ｜ [English](./README.en.md)

在 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)（DSH）里连接数据库，直接在对话中查数据、改数据。

- **左侧栏「数据库」面板**：浏览连接、表结构、分页数据，执行 SQL。
- **支持 SQLite / PostgreSQL / MySQL**，SQLite 无需额外安装驱动。

- **对话内「数据库」标签**：在当前对话里直接查看和操作已选数据库。
- **输入框旁多选下拉**：选择本次对话要使用的数据库，支持多选。
- **对话中直接操作**：内置 4 个助手工具，可以帮你查询、建表、写数据。
- **`/db` 指令**：输入 `/`，在指令列表里选择「数据库」，直接打开数据库面板。
- **查询历史**：对话数据库面板新增「查询历史」tab，按用户对话轮次分组、支持折叠，记录 SQL、连接、耗时和影响行数，点击即可复现；左侧全局面板的查询历史按对话分组，点击可进入对应对话。

从 npm 安装：

```bash

DSH_CLI="/Applications/DeepSeek Harness.app/Contents/Resources/runtime/cli/bin/dsh"
"$DSH_CLI" plugin --profile desktop add dsh-db-studio@1.0.3
```

也可以直接从 GitHub 安装：

```bash
"$DSH_CLI" plugin --profile desktop add github:etShaw-zh/dsh-db-studio
```

安装后**重启 DeepSeek Harness**。稳定版见 [Releases](https://github.com/etShaw-zh/dsh-db-studio/releases)。Windows / Linux 使用本机对应的 `dsh` 路径即可。

从源码安装：bash
git clone https://github.com/etShaw-zh/dsh-db-studio.git
"$DSH_CLI" plugin --profile desktop add "$PWD/dsh-db-studio"
```

1. 左侧栏点击「数据库」，新建连接，或使用内置示例数据库。
2. 在对话框里选中要用的数据库；也可以直接在对话里让助手操作：

> 查一下示例数据库里最近 10 笔订单，按金额排序
>
> 把 users 表里杭州的用户城市改成「杭州·西湖区」
>
> 给 orders 表加一个备注字段

助手只能访问当前对话选中的数据库；没选数据库时会先提示你选择。

插件配置写在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`，常用项：

| 配置 | 默认 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `demo` | `true` | 没有连接时自动创建示例数据库 |
| `allowWrite` | `true` | 是否允许写操作 |
| `agentTools` | `true` | 是否注册对话工具 |
| `maxRows` | `200` | 查询最多返回行数 |

- 连接信息保存在 `~/.dsh/dsh-db-studio/connections.json`，文件权限为 `0600`。
- 密码只保存在本机，不会发送到浏览器或模型上下文。
- 生产库建议使用只读账号、只读连接，或设置 `allowWrite: false`。

```bash
npm install
npm test
```

Connect to databases in [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH), then query and edit data right in the conversation.

- **Database panel in the sidebar**: browse connections, schemas and paginated data, and run SQL.
- **SQLite / PostgreSQL / MySQL**, with SQLite requiring no extra driver.

- **Database tab in a conversation**: view and work with the selected databases without leaving the chat.
- **Multi-select picker in the composer**: choose the databases this conversation may use.
- **Talk to the data**: four agent tools for querying, creating tables and writing data.
- **`/db` command**: type `/`, pick **Database** from the command list, and open the database panel.
- **Query history**: a **Query history** tab in the conversation database panel groups SQL by user turn, supports collapsing, and records SQL, connection, timing and affected rows; click an entry to load it back into the SQL editor. The global database panel groups the same history by conversation, and clicking a group opens that conversation.

From npm:

```bash

DSH_CLI="/Applications/DeepSeek Harness.app/Contents/Resources/runtime/cli/bin/dsh"
"$DSH_CLI" plugin --profile desktop add dsh-db-studio@1.0.3
```

Or install directly from GitHub:

```bash
"$DSH_CLI" plugin --profile desktop add github:etShaw-zh/dsh-db-studio
```

Restart DeepSeek Harness afterwards. Stable builds are listed in [Releases](https://github.com/etShaw-zh/dsh-db-studio/releases). On Windows / Linux use the `dsh` path installed on your machine.

From source:bash
git clone https://github.com/etShaw-zh/dsh-db-studio.git
"$DSH_CLI" plugin --profile desktop add "$PWD/dsh-db-studio"
```

1. Open **Database** in the sidebar and create a connection, or use the built-in demo database.
2. Select the databases for the conversation, then ask the assistant to work with them:

> Show me the 10 most recent orders in the demo database, sorted by amount.
>
> Change every Hangzhou user's city to “Hangzhou · West Lake”.
>
> Add a notes field to the orders table.

The assistant can only access databases selected for the conversation; if none are selected, it asks you to choose one first.

Set these in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

| Key | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `demo` | `true` | Create a demo database when there are no connections |
| `allowWrite` | `true` | Allow write operations |
| `agentTools` | `true` | Register the conversation tools |
| `maxRows` | `200` | Maximum rows returned by a query |

- Connections live in `~/.dsh/dsh-db-studio/connections.json` with file mode `0600`.
- Passwords stay on this machine and never reach the browser or the model context.
- For production databases, use a read-only account or connection, or set `allowWrite: false`.

```bash
npm install
npm test
```

Issues and PRs are welcome: <https://github.com/etShaw-zh/dsh-db-studio>
